metadata.title: SAARC Tourism & Culture Concessions and Heritage Parity Index

monuments.name: Taj Mahal, Agra
monuments.legal_basis: ASI Gazette Notification F. No. 33/7/2018-M; Rule 8 of AMASR Rules 1959
monuments.notes: SAARC citizens pay identical ticket rates as Indian citizens (₹50 vs ₹1,100 foreign visitors). Additional ₹200 fee for main mausoleum dome applies uniformly.

monuments.name: Red Fort Complex, Delhi
monuments.legal_basis: ASI Ticketed Monuments Schedule 2018; Section 38 of AMASR Act
monuments.notes: Online cashless booking parity: SAARC visitors use Indian domestic portal tier without foreign card surcharges.

monuments.name: Qutub Minar and its Monuments
monuments.legal_basis: ASI Schedule A Monuments Notification
monuments.notes: Includes access to Iron Pillar and Quwwat-ul-Islam mosque complex at domestic rates.

monuments.name: Ajanta & Ellora Caves
monuments.legal_basis: ASI Group B Monument Tariff Classification
monuments.notes: Covers rock-cut Buddhist, Hindu, and Jain monuments carved between 2nd century BCE and 10th century CE.

monuments.name: Mahabodhi Temple Complex & Nalanda
monuments.legal_basis: Bodh Gaya Temple Management Act & ASI Nalanda Excavated Site Rules
monuments.notes: Epicentre of the Pan-South Asian Buddhist pilgrimage circuit; domestic entry parity extended to all SAARC pilgrims.

monuments.name: Fatehpur Sikri Imperial Complex
monuments.legal_basis: ASI Ticketed Monuments Schedule 2018
monuments.notes: Preserves Mughal Emperor Akbar's 16th-century ceremonial capital and Buland Darwaza.

monuments.name: Sigiriya Rock Fortress
monuments.legal_basis: Central Cultural Fund Act No. 57 of 1980; CCF Tariff Directive 2024
monuments.notes: Standard foreign adult fee is $36 (approx LKR 10,800). SAARC passport holders pay exactly 50% ($18).

monuments.name: Ancient City of Polonnaruwa
monuments.legal_basis: CCF Cultural Triangle Concessionary Tariff Regulations
monuments.notes: Covers Gal Vihara, Quadrangle, and Royal Palace complex at flat $15 SAARC rate vs $30 foreign rate.

monuments.name: Sacred City of Anuradhapura
monuments.legal_basis: CCF Sacred Sites Regulatory Tariff
monuments.notes: Access to ancient monastic stupas including Ruwanwelisaya and Jetavanaramaya.

monuments.name: Rangiri Dambulla Cave Temple
monuments.legal_basis: Dambulla Temple Trust Board Bylaws
monuments.notes: Largest cave temple complex in Sri Lanka containing 153 Buddha statues and ancient murals.

monuments.name: Bhaktapur Durbar Square
monuments.legal_basis: Bhaktapur Municipality Tourism Entry Service Fee Bylaws
monuments.notes: Preserves 55-Window Palace, Nyatapola Temple, and pottery squares. Free for Nepalese citizens.

monuments.name: Kathmandu (Hanuman Dhoka) Durbar Square
monuments.legal_basis: Kathmandu Metropolitan City (KMC) Heritage Service Charge Directive
monuments.notes: Historical seat of Malla and Shah dynasties; SAARC nationals receive a 50% discount on municipal entry tickets.

monuments.name: Patan Durbar Square & Museum
monuments.legal_basis: Lalitpur Metropolitan City Heritage Conservation Rules
monuments.authority: Lalitpur Metropolitan City & Patan Museum Board
monuments.notes: Renowned for Newar metalcraft and Krishna Mandir stone temple; SAARC passport holders pay NPR 250 vs NPR 1,000.

monuments.name: Lumbini (Birthplace of Lord Buddha)
monuments.legal_basis: Lumbini Development Trust Act 2042 (1985); Fee Schedule 2023
monuments.notes: Sacred Garden and Maya Devi Temple complex; SAARC rate is NPR 200 vs NPR 500 for third-country tourists.

monuments.name: Swayambhunath Maha Chaitya (Monkey Temple)
monuments.legal_basis: Federation of Swayambhu Peace Committee Management Schedule
monuments.notes: Ancient hilltop stupa sacred to both Buddhists and Hindus.

monuments.name: Fort & Shalamar Gardens in Lahore
monuments.legal_basis: Walled City of Lahore Authority (WCLA) Act 2012; Punjab Tourism Tariff
monuments.authority: Walled City of Lahore Authority & Directorate General of Archaeology
monuments.notes: Mughal monument complex featuring Sheesh Mahal (Palace of Mirrors) and Naulakha Pavilion.

monuments.name: Taxila Archaeological Complex & Museum
monuments.legal_basis: Antiquities Act 1975; Federal Department of Archaeology & Museums Notification
monuments.authority: Department of Archaeology and Museums Pakistan
monuments.notes: Ancient Gandhara seat of Vedic and Buddhist learning, including Dharmarajika Stupa and Jaulian monastery.

monuments.name: Rohtas Fort
monuments.legal_basis: Punjab Archaeology & Tourism Service Bylaws
monuments.notes: Massive 16th-century military citadel built by Sher Shah Suri.

monuments.name: Archaeological Ruins at Moenjodaro
monuments.legal_basis: Sindh Cultural Heritage (Preservation) Act 1994
monuments.notes: Bronze Age metropolis of the Indus Valley Civilisation dating back to 2500 BCE.

monuments.name: Ruins of the Buddhist Vihara at Paharpur
monuments.legal_basis: Antiquities Act 1968 (amended 1976); Dept of Archaeology SRO 2021
monuments.notes: Somapura Mahavihara, the 8th-century intellectual hub that influenced Buddhist architecture throughout Southeast Asia.

monuments.name: Historic Mosque City of Bagerhat
monuments.legal_basis: Department of Archaeology Ticket Tariff Schedule
monuments.notes: Includes Sixty Dome Mosque (Shat Gombuj Masjid) and Khan Jahan Ali mausoleum.

monuments.name: Lalbagh Fort Archaeological Museum
monuments.legal_basis: Department of Archaeology Entry Fee Schedule
monuments.notes: 17th-century Mughal fort complex of Prince Muhammad Azam in Old Dhaka.

monuments.name: Paro Taktsang (Tiger's Nest Monastery)
monuments.legal_basis: Department of Culture & Dzongkha Development Monument Entry Fee Schedule 2022
monuments.authority: Department of Tourism & Central Monastic Body Bhutan
monuments.notes: Himalayan cliffside sacred site; SAARC passport holders pay Nu 1,000 (~$12) vs Nu 2,000 (~$24) third-country tourists.

monuments.name: Punakha Dzong (Palace of Great Happiness)
monuments.legal_basis: National Monument Entry Regulations
monuments.notes: Winter residence of the Je Khenpo and Central Monastic Body; free for Bhutanese citizens.

bhutan_sdf.title: Bhutan Sustainable Development Fee (SDF) Regional Concession
bhutan_sdf.legal_framework: Tourism Levy Act of Bhutan 2022 (Act No. 13 of 2022) as amended by Tourism Levy Amendment Act 2023
bhutan_sdf.authority: Department of Tourism, Royal Government of Bhutan

international.description: Standard statutory SDF for international tourists (reduced from $200 under 50% incentive directive effective Sept 2023 to Aug 2027).

indian.description: Special concessionary levy capped under bilateral agreement. Indian citizens pay in INR or Ngultrum directly.

bangladesh_maldives.description: Bilateral tourism MoU regime granting reciprocal subsidized entry rates for visiting Bangladeshi and Maldivian nationals.

other_saarc.description: Subject to standard international SDF unless traveling under official SVES protocol or diplomatic bilateral waivers.

family_comparison_7nights.scenario: Family of 4 traveling for 7 nights in Bhutan
family_comparison_7nights.summary: An Indian family saves nearly $2,400 in direct government tourism taxes alone on a 1-week holiday compared to a non-regional international family.

heritage_circuits.name: Pan-South Asian Buddhist Pilgrimage Circuit
heritage_circuits.route_description: Bodh Gaya (Mahabodhi) → Nalanda Mahavihara → Sarnath Archaeological Site → Kushinagar Parinirvana → Lumbini Sacred Garden & Maya Devi Temple
heritage_circuits.key_benefit: SAARC pilgrims pay only 13.7% of standard international ticket tariffs across the integrated cross-border Buddhist trail.

heritage_circuits.name: South Asian Grand UNESCO Heritage Circuit
heritage_circuits.route_description: Taj Mahal (Agra) → Red Fort (Delhi) → Sigiriya Rock Fortress (Sri Lanka) → Polonnaruwa (Sri Lanka) → Bhaktapur Durbar Square (Nepal) → Lahore Fort (Pakistan) → Taxila Ruins (Pakistan) → Somapura Mahavihara (Bangladesh)
heritage_circuits.key_benefit: Visiting all 8 flagship cultural sites across 5 nations costs a SAARC national under $40 in monument tickets vs over $111 for standard foreign visitors.

heritage_circuits.name: Eastern Himalayas & Dragon Kingdom Itinerary
heritage_circuits.theme: Mountain Monasteries, Dzongs & Bhutan SDF Concession
heritage_circuits.route_description: Kathmandu & Patan Durbar Squares (Nepal) → Paro Taktsang & Punakha Dzong (Bhutan) + 4 Nights Bhutan Tourism SDF Levy
heritage_circuits.key_benefit: Factoring in Bhutan's Sustainable Development Fee, regional travelers save over $360 per person on a short Himalayan mountain itinerary.

domestic_parity.label: Full Domestic Rate Parity
domestic_parity.desc: SAARC citizens pay the exact same entry ticket price as domestic citizens across all federally protected World Heritage monuments.

regional_concession.label: Substantial Regional Concession (50–85% off)
regional_concession.desc: A dedicated SAARC tariff tier granting 50% to 85% discount compared to general third-country international tourists.

bilateral_waiver.label: Bilateral Strategic Fee Waiver
bilateral_waiver.desc: Exemption from statutory foreign tourism levies (e.g., Bhutan SDF capped at ₹1,200/night vs $100/night international standard).

standard_foreign.label: Standard Foreign Tourist Tariff
standard_foreign.desc: Standard third-country foreigner tariff applies; no active bilateral or multilateral concession enacted.
